summary: Caught live 2026-08-23 while validating MPI-610. The Klein LoRA picker offered `flux2-klein\styles\9b\Chibi.safetensors` for a phase running `flux-2-klein-4b-int8-convrot`. ComfyUI logged a wall of `ERROR lora diffusion_model.single_blocks.N.linear1.weight shape '[27648, 3072]' is invalid for input of size 150994944` - every key rejected, 4B rank 3072 vs 9B 4096 - and then finished `execution_success` with 2 outputs. So the LoRA silently did nothing and the user reads the unchanged image as 'the rack is not wired'. It cost exactly that misreading in the MPI-610 session. Pre-existing (the same picker feeds the prompt box), but MPI-610 made it far easier to hit by giving a Flow a second, Klein-side rack. Klein cards carry no `loraFolder` so nothing filters the list by size tier.
